ValidationRule.description: You cannot change the Application Progress when Application Status is Capture, Ineligible, or Expired.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c ) ,ISCHANGED( Application_Progress__c ) , Not( ISBLANK(Application_Progress__c) ), OR( ISPICKVAL( Status ,"STATE_CAPTURE"),ISPICKVAL( Status ,"STATE_INELIGIBLE"),ISPICKVAL( Status ,"STATE_EXPIRED") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot change the Application Progress when Application Status is Capture, Ineligible, or Expired.
